newsitem.title: USA: Maystadt sees accord on IMF SDR allocation.
newsitem.headline: Maystadt sees accord on IMF SDR allocation.

text.p: Belgian Finance Minister Philippe Maystadt said on Sunday that he expected an agreement today on an amendment to IMF rules giving a special allocation of special drawing rights (SDR's) to all members.
But Maystadt told Reuters that he would not push for a specific figure today on an overall increase in SDRs.
"We will agree on an amendment for a special allocation for all members," Maystadt, who heads the IMF's Interim Committee, said ahead of the annual IMF meeting here.
Asked however what the likely figure would be on the increase in SDRs, he said "I won't push for a figure today."
Another delegation source said that he expected there to be progress on the SDR issue at today's meeting.
